about.textAfter: years of experience specializing in Java and Jira Development & Administration. I have a strong understanding of business processes, technical development, and analytical and debugging skills, and I'm always looking to learn new technologies while applying my skills and experience to solve real problems.

bullets: Develop and maintain automation workflows, and build plugins to extend Jira capabilities.
Build dashboards for Jira Connect add-ons, configure custom fields and preset filters, test outcomes, and identify defects.
Handle customer demand end-to-end through Groovy scripting.
Delivered success stories: Project Creation Automation, Archive Issue Search, WoW Panel, CROWD Admin Finder, JMP Self Service Portal.
Developed and supported multiple UST client projects, interacting directly with customers.
Met multiple project objectives with client appreciation.
Led "Color Gold" — an organizational branding initiative — running industrial visits and high-impact events.

experience.role: Specialist Application Operations — Jira Admin cum Developer
bullets: Handled demand requests that operations couldn't process, by building custom scripts.
Developed add-ons and customizations for the Atlassian Jira platform.
Built custom workflows, reports, dashboards, and metrics using Jira APIs for stakeholder insight.
Maintained plugin compatibility and instance performance stability; produced technical documentation.
Built Jira Groovy (ScriptRunner) scripts and custom workflows with conditions, validators, and post-functions.
Installed, configured, and rolled out key Jira plugins; managed Jira Data Center on AWS.
Ran demos for end customers and senior management within Agile/Scrum teams.
Worked closely with clients to gather requirements and resolve problems.
Suggested a new digitization methodology and validated BPDs against the digitized versions.
Developed features and components aligned to the client's business needs.
Developed custom changes in a mainframe database and maintained existing custom code.
Tested manual membership claim processing, and combined membership/claim adjudication testing.
Built macros to automate time-consuming manual processes.

achievements.text: Cost savings from launching the JMP Self Service Portal with innovative search functionality.
Saved by automating project, space, and group creation in Jira.
Saved by building an "Archive Issue Search" feature for efficient issue retrieval.
Cost benefit from a release management feature used as a team knowledge base.
Recognized as an **Atlassian Community Champion** for Trivandrum.
Received the **Navrathna Recognition 2023** and **GEM-Spot Recognition 2023** for exceptional learning and rapid application of new skills.
Logged ~395 learning hours, ranking as a top learner on BranchIT 2023.
Finalist, Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2018 — Hubli, Karnataka.
Won first prize (Raspberry Pi Kit) in a Raspberry Pi project idea competition, and served as a jury member for the Raspberry Pi Foundation's "Coolest Projects" initiative.
